rationale: Raw source contains separate current and comparative investment schedules. The September 30, 2023 schedule totals at table 61 row 6, while the December 31, 2022 comparative schedule totals at table 119 row 9. A flagged Balrog second-lien loan appears in the comparative schedule at table 114 row 17, whereas the current schedule contains a different Balrog first-lien loan at table 53 row 11. This supports the PP03 flag: comparative-period position rows were retained as 2023-09-30 holdings.
